paragraphs.source_en: On the twentieth day of the eighth month of the first year of Tenshō, Tokugawa Ieyasu captured Nagashino Castle, while Okudaira Mimasaka and his son miraculously escaped the Takeda army's pursuit, crossed Mount Iwasaki, and entered Takiyama Castle. Takeda Katsuyori, who had come all the way from Kai with reinforcements, found his army scattered and unable to support itself from front to rear because of Ieyasu's tenacious resistance and the stratagems of the Okudairas. Meanwhile, the lord of Nagashino Castle, Suganuma Shinpachirō Sadamasa, cast aside his armor and fled in panic toward Hōraiji Temple.
